finding.claim: Stored subscriber callbackUrl (set via subscribe) is used as the target of a server-side HTTP POST every minute by notifyAll with no scheme, host, or IP validation. An attacker who can reach subscribe can make the server POST a fixed payload to arbitrary internal or external hosts on a recurring schedule (blind SSRF; response body is read but never returned to the caller).

finding.guards_checked: subscribe(): no validation at all (line 13-15). notifyAll(): no validation (line 18-26). Redirects: client is HttpClient.newHttpClient() (line 10), whose default redirect policy is NEVER, so redirect-based pivot is not available. Response is not returned to the subscriber (blind). No allowlist, scheme restriction, or CIDR egress control exists in this repo. Auth on the /subscribe route cannot be verified from this code. Possible DEPLOY-REC exemption if the application's documented purpose is user-configured webhooks; not determinable from this file alone. Severity: HIGH if /subscribe is reachable without authentication (Check 4 two-hop), MEDIUM if it requires auth or if the caller is admin-only.
